name: codex-task-messenger
tagline_zh: 多个 Codex 任务挤在同一目录各干各的，互不搭理？现在你喊一嗓子，隔壁任务就能接话、传结果、等回音。
tagline_en: Multiple Codex tasks in one folder, each in its own bubble? Now you can ping, hand off context, wait for replies.
desc_en: Communicate between existing local Codex App tasks that share one working directory. Use when the user asks to list or inspect same-directory tasks, send one a message or context handoff, ask a task to return a result, wait for that result, continue a request that needs user input, present an inbound task reply, or explicitly broadcast a one-way notice. Also use for Codex delegations that invoke $
why_zh: 它不靠外部队列或数据库，直接在同目录任务间传话，零配置，且能同步等待结果，这是别的 skill 做不到。
why_en: No external queue or DB—it talks directly between same-directory tasks, zero setup, and can synchronously wait for results.
